Bea: Tiny office emergency: the desk gnome has gone missing a hat. Assemble at 11 for a gentle inquiry. :point_up: :mag_right:
Anil: I last saw it near the plant kingdom. Possible hat theft or bold fashion statement.
Gus: Evidence: small glitter trail leading to the break room. I can fingerpaint the timeline.
Rena: Poll: return hat to gnome, upgrade gnome with new hat, or start a hat fund? React :repeat: = return, :sparkles: = upgrade, :moneybag: = fund
Bea: :sparkles: for upgrade
Anil: :moneybag: for fund (I will contribute one coffee coin)
Gus: :repeat: I vote return and apology note.
Snack-Bot: Reminder: do not glue any accessories without owner consent. Also, leftover donuts labeled.
Bea: Micro-challenge: best one-liner about the gnome wins two mini-donuts. Keep it clean.
Anil: "Gnomebody puts baby in the corner."
Gus: "Hat's off to whoever staged this."
Rena: "Gnome one likes a hatless mystery." :laughing:
Echo-Bot: Reaction tally: Anil +2 :thumbsup:, Gus +1 :laughing:, Rena +1 :heart:
Bea: Winner: Anil. Donuts reserved. Please narrate the handover with dramatic whisper.
Anil: Will provide whisper narration and a tiny hat consecration ceremony. Also bringing spare ribbon.
Gus: I'll scope for the glitter trail cleanup crew.
Rena: Can we add a small 'found hat' box by the reception? Sometimes small items run away.
Snack-Bot: Calendar created: "Gnome Hat Handover" 11:00 AM today.
Bea: Thanks team. If you find more missing accessories, please escalate to me or leave in the box. Mystery-solving kits (tweezer + tiny bag) welcome. :package:
